title: How to post a trial reel on Instagram?
excerpt: Instagram keeps shipping new features that help creators and brands manage their content better. One of those tools is the trial reel, which reaches people outside your community first. The video goes to people who don't follow you – and if the test results look good, one tap shares the reel with your followers too.
metaTitle: How to post a trial reel on Instagram?

runs.text: The video goes first to people who don't follow you – and if the test results look good, one tap shares the reel with your followers too. After 24 hours you'll see engagement stats – you can check how your reel did on interactions and whether it's worth publishing more widely.
How do you post a trial reel? Three short steps!
Open the Instagram app. Make sure you're on the latest version so you have access to all the current features.
Add a video or record a new reel (right inside the app).

Flip the “Trial reel” toggle (you'll find it under the uploaded video – depending on whether you're on Android or iOS the look may differ slightly, but the option is always there at this stage of posting a reel):
Trial reels will help you push your creativity, reach new audiences and work out which content has the most viral potential.
Now that you know how it's done – time to test! 🙂
